prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a richly hand-painted chibi Chinese wuxia 2D RPG. Landscape 1536x1024 transparent RGBA. EXACTLY 8 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 32 separate complete poses of ONE identical creature. Columns LEFT to RIGHT: S toward viewer, SE bottom-right, E right profile, NE back-right, N completely away, NW back-left, W left profile, SW front-left. Rows TOP to BOTTOM: walk stride A, neutral idle, walk stride B with opposite limbs, melee attack contact. Elevated orthographic camera 25 degrees. True directional anatomy: rear views show back without face. Same proportions, equipment, scale and upper-left light in every cell. Each body centered with LARGE transparent gutters. All limbs, tails, weapons and sleeves fit completely inside their own cell and never touch neighbors. Compact coherent silhouette, appendages connected to body. Rich painted material and volume, crisp dark silhouette edge and restrained highlights, readable at game scale. No text, borders, grid, scenery, floor, ground shadows, detached effects or particles. ACTUAL transparent background. Subject:

species.subject: A walking treant with sturdy dark walnut trunk, two branch arms ending in root fingers, two short root legs, expressive amber eye knots and stern bark mouth on front only. Compact lush emerald leaf crown with small attached purple fungi. Alternate root feet in walk rows, idle arms low, attack sweeps one thick branch arm forward. Back has bark and moss, no eyes. Friendly proportions but threatening expression, no human clothes.

A squat giant venomous spider, exactly EIGHT articulated legs around a compact violet-black rounded abdomen and small head, clustered ruby eyes on front, ivory fangs, amethyst markings and purple glossy carapace. Legs kept bent and close enough to fit cells. Walk alternates leg groups, idle low stance, attack raises front pair and lunges fangs. Rear shows abdomen without face, no scorpion tail, no wings.

A small floating jade-green fox spirit with two pointed ears, bright pale mint face and chest, dark emerald almond eyes, tiny attached forepaws, one compact curling flame tail attached to the ghostly body. Semi-translucent emerald outer edges but opaque readable cream core. Walk rows sway tail opposite directions, idle floats upright, attack lunges paws first. Back shows green fur and tail with no face. No detached flames or particles.

A sinister adult human male shadow taoist, chibi proportions, silver hair tied in topknot, narrow stern face, deep plum and black layered Chinese robes with violet embroidered borders, wooden prayer beads, short dark staff with attached amethyst finial. Two hands two feet, compact sleeves. Walk alternate boots, idle staff upright, attack thrusts staff with one palm forward. Back shows robe and silver topknot without face. No hat, no giant halo.

A powerful FOUR-LEGGED black bear with thick charcoal-brown fur, rounded ears, broad tan muzzle, thick paws, small angry amber eyes and short tail. Subtle olive moss caught in shoulder fur. True bear anatomy, no tusks, no boar snout, no armor. Walk alternate diagonal paws, idle all four feet grounded, attack raises a forepaw for a heavy claw swipe while rear feet remain grounded. Back shows broad furry rump, no face.

A heavy squat forest stone golem, TWO thick legs and TWO enormous fists, angular olive-grey limestone body with dark joints, thick bright moss shoulders, attached roots winding around stone limbs, small recessed head with magenta eye slits. Compact fern growth attached to upper back. Walk opposing legs and arms, idle fists lowered, attack one fist thrust forward. Back shows stone and moss with no face. No floating rocks.

Boss thousand-year demon tree, majestic hulking walking ancient walnut trunk with two thick root legs and two claw-like branch arms. Broad compact burgundy and violet foliage crown, three subtle demonic bark face knots on front of torso, central red eyes, pale exposed heartwood scars, winding mossy roots. Larger ornate visual detail than ordinary treant. Back solid gnarled bark with no face. Walking alternate root feet, idle spreading branch claws, attack powerful forward branch slam. No floating leaves, no detached magic.

A spectral adult Chinese palace spearman, blue-grey lamellar armor, faded slate robe, aged steel helmet, pale blue human face with cyan eyes, compact tattered cloak. One short steel spear held close with blade fully inside cell. Exactly two hands and two boots, opaque painted body with faint cyan highlights. Walk alternate legs, idle spear diagonal, attack spear thrust. Back shows helmet and cloak, no face.

A continuous compact coiled stone python with no limbs or wings, large grey-taupe scales like weathered masonry, ivory segmented belly, dark diamond markings, orange eyes and small blunt stone horn ridges on narrow snake head. Full tail contained inside cell. Walk rows shift coils opposite ways, idle head raised, attack extends neck forward baring fangs. Rear shows patterned scales and back of head without face.

A walking Chinese stone door guardian statue, squat humanoid with two stout feet and two massive hands, carved layered warrior armor in weathered grey limestone, fierce sculpted face, small orange glowing eyes, moss in cracks, ornamental curled shoulder reliefs. No human flesh. Walk opposite feet and arms, idle fists lowered, attack punches with one large carved fist. Rear armor carvings no face.

A ghostly adult female Chinese court dancer in chibi game proportions, long black hair with silver hairpin, pale moonlit face, flowing compact rose-mauve hanfu, long silk sleeves curled close to body, lower hem tapering into a coherent spectral tail. Two graceful hands visible. Pale cyan edge light with opaque lavender fabric. Walk rows sway sleeves and hem opposite ways, idle poised, attack extends one curled silk sleeve and palm forward. Rear shows hair and robe, no face. No detached ribbons.

A supernatural HEADLESS Chinese palace guard: EMPTY high armored collar with no head and no gore, dark iron lamellar armor with faded crimson trim, compact ragged burgundy cape, two armored hands and two boots. Holds one short broad steel sabre. Ominous clean silhouette, small dim cyan glow inside empty collar. Walk alternate legs, idle sword low, attack sweeping sabre forward within cell. Never add a head, skull or face.

A large spectral raven, charcoal-black plumage with blue-violet sheen, two compact folded wings, two taloned feet, ivory beak, cyan eyes and attached pale cyan feather tips. Small swept crest and short fan tail. Walk rows stepping opposite feet with subtle wing lift, idle wings folded, attack beak lunge with wings partly lifted but narrow. Rear shows folded wing feathers and tail, no face. No detached ghost flames.

Boss spectral Chinese war general, powerful adult male with blue-grey supernatural skin, stern cyan eyes, ornate dark iron lamellar armor, silver carved dragon pauldrons, compact dark navy cloak, crown-like helmet with two short ivory horns, cyan breastplate gem. Two massive hands and two armored boots. Holds one broad silver guandao blade on a SHORT haft kept close to body. Walk alternate legs, idle weapon diagonal, attack heavy blade strike inside cell. Rear cloak and helmet, no face. Regal threatening wuxia demon warrior, no detached aura.

A majestic FOUR-LEGGED white guardian tiger, ivory-white fur with charcoal stripes, pale blue eyes, powerful shoulders, rounded feline ears, one long striped tail curled close to body, small gold jade collar. Real feline face and paws. Walk alternating diagonal pairs, idle all four paws grounded, attack pounces with forepaws and open fangs. Back shows striped rump and curled tail, no face. No wings or flames.

A sacred Chinese red-crowned crane, white ivory feathered body, black folded wing tips and tail, slim charcoal legs, elegant long neck curved compactly, red crown, long dark beak and small gold throat ornament. Two wings kept mostly folded. Walk opposite legs, idle upright elegant posture, attack compact wing-assisted forward beak thrust. Warm gold highlights on white feathers, no fire cloud or detached effects. Back view has back of neck and wings, no face.

An adult bald Chinese martial monk in chibi proportions, serene stern face, saffron-orange robe over burgundy undergarments, cream cloth wraps on wrists and shins, large wooden prayer beads, two feet and hands holding a short polished oak combat staff with brass caps. Walk alternate feet, idle balanced stance staff close diagonal, attack controlled forward staff strike. Back shows bald head and robe folds with no face. No halo or floating beads.

A massive squat ancient Chinese bronze temple automaton, two thick articulated legs and enormous fists, dark bronze plates with jade-green patina in recesses, carved cloud motifs, small mask-like head with warm golden eye slits, round sun emblem on chest. Heavy rounded shoulders, no floating pieces. Walk opposing legs and arms, idle fists low, attack forceful one-fist punch. Back engraved bronze plates with no face.

A regal emerald jade naga serpent with NO legs and NO wings, compact continuous coiled body, ivory segmented belly, gold scale markings, two small golden antler horns, broad elegant cobra-like hood framing dragon-serpent face with red eyes. Tail curled tightly within cell. Walk shifts coils opposite ways, idle hood upright, attack neck lunges forward with open fangs. Back shows jade hood and scales, no face. Polished jade surface with gold details, no detached glow.

A majestic FOUR-LEGGED Chinese guardian lion, rich golden fur, dense curled amber mane, broad feline muzzle, ivory fangs, cream belly, large strong paws, one curled tufted tail, small jade forehead ornament. Compact regal silhouette. Walk alternate diagonal paws, idle four paws grounded, attack forward claw swipe with open roaring mouth. Rear shows curled mane back, haunches and tail, no face. No wings, no saddle, no floating effects.

Boss martial war demon king, towering muscular adult humanoid in ornate antique gold and black Chinese lamellar armor, warm bronze skin, fierce white-gold eyes, crown helmet with two compact curved ivory horns, ruby breastplate gem, layered crimson waist sash and compact burgundy cape. Holds one broad golden cleaver in a strong hand, two armored boots. Walk alternate legs, idle weapon low, attack a powerful compact downward cleaver strike. Rear golden armor and cape without face. Ornate menacing boss, not Western knight, no detached aura.

A squat volcanic scorpion with EIGHT compact jointed walking legs, TWO strong pincers and ONE segmented tail curled above its back, black basalt carapace with restrained bright ember-orange cracks, small gold eyes and glowing attached sting tip. Legs and tail kept inside cell. Walk alternate leg groups, idle pincers low tail curled, attack reaches one pincer and bends stinger forward. Rear shows segmented tail base and carapace, no face. No detached lava droplets.

A powerful FOUR-LEGGED fire tiger, burnt orange fur with black charcoal stripes, cream-gold muzzle and belly, amber eyes, flame-shaped but solid fur tufts along shoulders, one long striped tail curled close with an attached ember-colored tuft. Real feline paws and rounded ears. Walk alternate diagonal paws, idle grounded, attack lunges forepaws and fangs. Rear striped rump and tail without face. No external fire aura or floating sparks.

A huge squat molten rock golem, two thick short legs and two enormous articulated fists, angular charcoal basalt plates separated by glowing orange magma seams, tiny recessed head with bright gold eyes, heavy craggy shoulders and a bright molten chest fissure. Everything connected, no floating rocks. Walk opposite legs and arms, idle fists down, attack heavy fist punch forward. Back shows dark basalt and lava seams, no face. No loose flames or particles.

A regal Chinese fire phoenix bird, scarlet and orange painted feathers, gold cream breast, curved golden beak, elegant attached golden crest, two folded wings with layered amber feather tips, two taloned feet and a short compact curling ornamental red tail. Keep wings and tail close enough to fit narrow cells. Walk alternate feet and slight wing lift, idle proud upright, attack forward peck with partially raised wings. Back feathers and crest with no face. No detached flames, no giant trailing tail.

A compact juvenile fire dragon with FOUR sturdy legs plus TWO tightly folded bat-like wings, one curled tail, short ivory horns, burgundy-red scales and golden orange belly plates, charcoal wing membranes, amber eyes. Strong cute-menacing muzzle. Walk alternate diagonal paws, idle four paws grounded, attack crouched forward bite with wings slightly lifted still compact. Rear shows wings, hindquarters and tail without face. No breath cloud, no detached flames.

An adult male Chinese infernal spear commander in chibi proportions, charcoal and burgundy lamellar armor with brass dragon details, warm tan stern human face, red plume on compact brass helmet, short dark red cape, two armored boots and two hands holding a short ember-tipped bronze spear. Walk alternate legs, idle spear diagonal close to body, attack spear thrust inside cell. Rear helmet and cape without face. No huge flame halo, no detached sparks.

Boss ancient fire dragon: majestic hulking FOUR-LEGGED dragon with TWO compact folded wings, deep oxblood and black layered scales, ivory swept-back horns, broad powerful dragon head with gold eyes, molten amber chest and belly plates, attached bronze dorsal ridges, thick tail coiled close. Heavy regal proportions distinct from juvenile drake. Walk alternate diagonal paws, idle grounded wings tucked, attack heavy forward bite with foreclaws and wings slightly raised but contained. Rear wings, armored back and tail without face. No fire breath or detached particles.
